summary: Session 3 of 3 (last session) — tri-provider review and implementation-set spec for crud-scaffolding-spike. Routed reviews from Gemini Pro (APPROVE WITH ADJUSTMENTS) and GPT-5.4 (NEEDS REWORK) plus an Opus self-contribution (with explicit context-asymmetry disclosure) synthesized into a consolidated review with 7 BLOCKING + 4 SUBSTANTIVE + 3 MINOR adjustments. Small-scope adjustments applied INLINE to the proposal (invalid @bind-Value Razor replaced with platform-convention Value/ValueChanged, multi-column sort fixed to OrderBy+ThenBy, controller auth-before-mutation fixed, MudForm validation pattern corrected, RenderFragment rewritten as Razor markup, ITemplateOperationProvider reflection hook removed, OData --filter-mode wording purged, QBE TODO replaced with ApplyQbeFilter call, Section 5 retitled and rewritten as schema-file-primary, Conclusion rewritten). Larger BLOCKING adjustments captured as MVP gates in the new implementation-set spec at docs/session-sets/crud-scaffolding/spec.md (5 sessions, requiresUAT/requiresE2E both false). Verification took 3 rounds — Round 1 found 3 Major + 1 Minor; Round 2 found 1 Major (B4 schema-primary incomplete); Round 3 VERIFIED clean.
